description: Core, verifiable facts for active Indian credit cards — fees, eligibility, reward rates, point values and perk types. Independent, no paid placements. Free to cite with attribution.
citation: CardAdvisor — India Credit Card Facts Dataset, live snapshot as of 2026-10-16. For a citable, immutable version see https://cardadvisor.in/data/versions.

fieldDictionary.cardKey: Stable slug; the card detail page is /cards/{cardKey}.
fieldDictionary.name: Official card name.
fieldDictionary.annualFeeRs: Recurring annual fee in ₹ (0 if none; null if the issuer has not disclosed it).
fieldDictionary.joiningFeeRs: One-time joining fee in ₹ (0 if none; null if the issuer has not disclosed it).
fieldDictionary.lifetimeFree: True only if genuinely no annual fee AND no spend-based waiver condition.
fieldDictionary.feeWaiverSpendRs: Annual spend in ₹ that waives the annual fee; null if not waivable.
fieldDictionary.forexMarkupPct: Foreign-currency markup as a percentage (before 18% GST); null if unpublished.
fieldDictionary.aprMonthlyPct: Monthly finance charge (APR) as a percentage; null if unpublished.
fieldDictionary.minSalaryRs: Minimum income the issuer states, in ₹ a month: a yearly figure is divided by 12 and rounded to the rupee. null if unpublished.
fieldDictionary.minAgeYears: Minimum applicant age; null if unpublished.
fieldDictionary.maxAgeYears: Maximum applicant age; null if unpublished.
fieldDictionary.rewardRateMinPct: Base earn rate as a % of spend (real cash value, excludes portal accelerators).
fieldDictionary.rewardRateMaxPct: Best category earn rate as a % of spend (real cash value, excludes portal accelerators).
fieldDictionary.lastVerified: Date this card record last CHANGED (yyyy-mm-dd) — a change stamp set on any edit, NOT a claim that the record was re-checked against the issuer that day.
fieldDictionary.rewards: Per-category earn rows: category, rewardType, ratePct (EFFECTIVE cash return as a % of spend, i.e. points-per-₹1 × pointValuePaisa — directly comparable across points and cashback cards), monthlyCapRs, pointValuePaisa, merchants (scope; portal/co-brand rows are marked). Sorted by category, then merchants, with the unscoped row first.
fieldDictionary.perks: Perks the card carries, one row per perk, sorted by perkType (INSURANCE, LOUNGE_ACCESS, …). Our rupee valuation of each perk is editorial and is not part of the open dataset.
